## Intake Form (prototype)
Receives submissions from intake.html (repo) and emails
the team. New-client intake ahead of the discovery
meeting: contact info, teammates to CC, company +
website + socials, industry (for tagging), and the one
main pain point they plan to raise.

Recipient is fixed (kavya@ + saanchi@) — change here
when the team decides where intake should route.
